subject: CS352
filterSummary: Selected 10 videos, 5 for English and 5 for Arabic, covering all specified topics in project management. The selections prioritize high relevance to student pain points, strong educational quality, and high viewership as a proxy for peer validation. All hard gates were applied, and channel diversity was considered to provide varied teaching styles.
